system.description:
Your keen perception pierces the ethereal veil, granting you the ability to see into the spirit realm.

Prerequisites Perception 5 ranks Sense Motive 5 ranks

You can see incorporeal creatures clearly and any magical attacks you make against them inflict damage normally. Furthermore, the flat check DC that a hidden target makes to avoid your attacks increases by 2 (usually 10 to 12).

Applied automatically: your magical weapon Strikes against an incorporeal creature ignore its immunity to non-magical attacks and its resistance to all damage (as Ghost Touch does), and a hidden creature's flat check to avoid your attacks is 2 harder. Not automated: the same for your spells, whose damage path has no such switch yet; seeing incorporeal creatures is yours to declare.

effects.name: Ethereal Sight: ethereal sight
effects.description: Your magical attacks affect incorporeal creatures normally; the flat check a hidden target makes to avoid your attacks is 2 higher.
